body.name: Rademacher-partition exponential-Hermite handle
body.construction: Use a growing finite partition of \(\mathcal X\), random cell signs, moment-matched nuisance-shift priors, and positive exponential-Hermite tilts of the primitive treatment-residual density; certify support in the primitive branches, the supplied-fit radii, and bounded chi-square distance between the induced projected evaluation mixtures.
